name: New York
overview: New York offers a small refundable low-income owner/renter credit and separate Basic/Enhanced STAR school-property-tax relief.

programs.name: Real Property Tax Credit
programs.ageRule: All ages; higher schedule if claimant, spouse or a claimed dependent is 65+.
programs.incomeDefinition: Federal adjusted gross income starting in tax year 2025, replacing the prior household-income basis.
programs.maximumBenefit: 2025: up to $75 under age 65, or $375 under the senior schedule.
programs.formulaSummary: Starting in 2025, use fixed FAGI-tiered credit amounts and the age schedule; the older excess-property-tax formula no longer applies.
programs.application: IT-214 with IT-201, or standalone IT-214 if no income return is otherwise required.
eligibilityNotes: Full-year resident, same residence at least six months, not claimable as a dependent.
All owned real-property market value must not exceed $85,000.
Qualifying renters face a $450 average-monthly occupancy-rent ceiling.
Residence must not be fully property-tax exempt.

programs.name: Basic and Enhanced STAR Credit
programs.ageRule: Basic has no age restriction; Enhanced generally requires age 65+, with spouse/sibling and survivor exceptions.
programs.incomeDefinition: STAR income generally equals FAGI minus taxable IRA distributions; 2025 benefits use 2023 income.
programs.incomeLimits: 2025 Basic credit income limit $500,000; Enhanced income limit $107,300. Legacy Basic exemption limit $250,000.
programs.maximumBenefit: Location-specific school-tax savings; no uniform statewide dollar credit.
programs.formulaSummary: State-calculated credit based on eligible STAR school-tax relief; Basic and Enhanced are alternatives.
programs.application: Register for the STAR credit; existing exemption recipients follow separate rules.
eligibilityNotes: Owned principal residence and owner-specific income rules apply.
2025 Enhanced eligibility can include income of nonresident owners.
interactions: Cannot receive both STAR credit and STAR exemption on the same property.
programs.programYear: 2025 benefit year uses 2023 income; property/school-district facts are necessary.

laterChanges: For 2026 Enhanced STAR, the income limit becomes $110,750 and owner-income eligibility rules change. Do not apply those changes to the 2025 comparison.
researchNotes: The IT-214 formula changed materially in 2025; presence of an older model variable does not validate the new calculation.
IT-229 real property tax relief credit is discontinued; it is not an additional 2025 program. Source: https://www.tax.ny.gov/forms/form_number_order_income.htm.
Local senior/disability exemptions require separate local adoption and are not enumerated here.
